author: postwar_recovery
scope: Selective DHS creation and use supplement; public primary records with explicitly limited institutional excerpts and one original scholarly counter-perspective.

sources.title: First anniversary of the Department of Homeland Security: White House fact sheet
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning On March 1, 2003; parsed lines 158–162
sources.short_claim: Personnel from 22 organizations joined DHS on March 1, 2003.
sources.limitations: Organizational chronology is used; administration claims of improved effectiveness are not adopted. Not every predecessor was transferred in its entirety.

sources.title: DHS operational and support components
sources.locator: Indexed component list
sources.access_level: Official search-index excerpt; direct open blocked
sources.short_claim: Lists USCIS, Coast Guard, CBP, CISA, FEMA, FLETC, ICE and Secret Service as components.
sources.limitations: Dateline is as indexed. Full page unavailable; listing does not verify staffing, powers or functioning of every office. Functions are separately grounded where possible.

sources.title: Executive Office for Immigration Review: About the Office
sources.locator: EOIR Mission; Background Information; parsed lines 43–49
sources.short_claim: EOIR adjudicates immigration cases under delegated Attorney General authority within DOJ.
sources.limitations: Undated live page. Organizational separation from DHS does not mean Article III judicial independence.

sources.title: 14 U.S.C. §101: Establishment of Coast Guard
sources.locator: Section 101, first paragraph and historical notes
sources.short_claim: The Coast Guard is a military service and branch of the armed forces at all times.
sources.limitations: Edition year, not original enactment date. This provision does not make every DHS component military or give ICE Coast Guard powers.

sources.title: GAO-04-586: First Phase of Visitor and Immigration Status Program Operating, but Improvements Needed
sources.locator: Highlights; printed pp. 6, 29; Appendix III initial deployment discussion
sources.short_claim: Initial biometric entry capability began January 5, 2004; exit functionality remained limited.
sources.limitations: Historical implementation review, not proof of a complete entry/exit system or demonstrated net security benefit. Publication precision is month.

sources.title: Public Law 110-53: Implementing Recommendations of the 9/11 Commission Act of 2007
sources.locator: Section 511; 121 Stat. 317 onward; PDF p. 53
sources.short_claim: Establishes the DHS State, Local, and Regional Fusion Center Initiative.
sources.limitations: Statutory initiative is not proof that DHS owns every center, that all centers operate alike, or that all planned support was delivered.

sources.title: Federal Support for and Involvement in State and Local Fusion Centers: Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations staff report
sources.locator: Executive summary, printed pp. 1–5; sections on counterterrorism reporting and privacy review
sources.short_claim: Finds poor federal counterterrorism reporting and privacy problems; also describes reports stopped by privacy review.
sources.limitations: Reviewed reporting includes April 2009–April 2010. Findings do not establish that every center lacked every local public-safety benefit; potential legal problems are not court judgments.

sources.title: GAO-12-708: Secure Communities—Criminal Alien Removals Increased, but Technology Planning Improvements Needed
sources.locator: Highlights; printed pp. 1, 7–8, 12–16; Figures 1–3
sources.access_level: Official GAO evaluation of ICE data and implementation
sources.short_claim: A 2008 program connected local booking fingerprints through FBI to DHS checks; removals included people without known criminal convictions.
sources.limitations: October 2008–March 2012 removal cohort is historical. Missing charge data and selected interviews limit inference; no current ICE-wide proportions are inferred.

sources.title: Secretary Jeh Johnson memorandum: Secure Communities
sources.locator: All three pages; opening discontinuation and Priority Enforcement Program instructions
sources.access_level: Original government memorandum, readable AILA mirror
sources.short_claim: Directs replacement with Priority Enforcement Program while retaining fingerprint-based information sharing.
sources.limitations: Original DHS URL blocked. This directive changed program priorities and requests; it did not erase the data connection or establish present policy.

sources.title: Executive Order 13768: Enhancing Public Safety in the Interior of the United States
sources.locator: Section 10
sources.short_claim: Orders termination of PEP and restoration of Secure Communities.
sources.limitations: Historical directive only. Later administrations changed immigration policy; this is not presented as current legal advice or an uninterrupted policy through 2026.

sources.title: OIG-21-31: DHS Had Authority to Deploy Federal Law Enforcement Officers to Protect Federal Facilities in Portland, Oregon, but Should Ensure Better Planning and Execution in Future Cross-Component Activities
sources.locator: Results summary; cross-designation authority; printed pp. 8–12 on training, equipment and uniforms
sources.access_level: Official DHS Inspector General report, hosted by Oversight.gov
sources.short_claim: Finds authority and execution deficiencies; reviewed uniforms complied with component identification rules.
sources.limitations: Report date differs from May 3 catalog issue/posting date. Review is not a ruling on every arrest, force incident or visibility dispute.

sources.title: Public Law 119-21: DHS border and immigration appropriations
sources.locator: Sections 90002–90003; 139 Stat. 358; PDF p. 288 for detention appropriation
sources.short_claim: Appropriates $45 billion for ICE detention capacity, available through September 30, 2029; also funds CBP capacity.
sources.limitations: Budget authority is not spending, completed construction, occupied beds, staffing on duty or an outcome measurement. Other agencies also receive funding elsewhere in the law.

sources.title: ICE launches Operation Midway Blitz: DHS announcement
sources.locator: Announcement headline and indexed excerpt
sources.access_level: Official agency announcement, indexed only; full open blocked
sources.short_claim: DHS announces Chicago-area Operation Midway Blitz.
sources.limitations: Establishes announcement and stated purpose, not every arrest, allegation, motive or operational outcome.

sources.title: DHS statement on Operation Midway Blitz in Chicago
sources.locator: Indexed excerpt identifying ICE and CBP personnel
sources.access_level: Official agency statement, indexed only; full open blocked
sources.short_claim: DHS describes ICE and CBP participation in the operation.
sources.limitations: Interested account. Arrest totals, characterization of targets and claims about critics are not independently adopted.

sources.title: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency Act of 2018, Public Law 115-278
sources.locator: Section 2; amended Homeland Security Act §2202; approval line
sources.short_claim: Establishes CISA within DHS with cybersecurity, infrastructure-security and emergency-communications responsibilities.
sources.limitations: CISA is an evolution of existing DHS infrastructure functions, not evidence those functions began from nothing in 2018. Authority does not prove present operational capacity.

sources.title: TSA recognizes the twentieth anniversary of its establishment
sources.locator: Release title and mission descriptions
sources.short_claim: TSA protects transportation systems.
sources.limitations: Used only for role description. Agency anniversary advocacy does not establish performance.

sources.title: We Are FEMA: Publication 1
sources.locator: Title and indexed mission statement
sources.short_claim: FEMA helps people before, during and after disasters.
sources.limitations: Filename identifies a 2025 edition; exact publication date and full text were not verified. Used only for stable mission description, not 2026 staffing or effectiveness.

sources.title: United States Secret Service FY2012 annual report
sources.locator: Indexed mission description
sources.access_level: Official report indexed excerpt; direct open failed
sources.short_claim: Secret Service combines protective responsibilities with investigations protecting financial integrity.
sources.limitations: Fiscal 2012 reporting period is not the publication or hosting date. Only mission description is used; no current performance inference.

sources.title: Operation Midway Blitz: A New Experiment in Federal Power, Robert A. Pape
sources.locator: Dateline and introduction; survey summary reviewed but not adopted
sources.access_level: University-hosted original research and author interpretation
sources.short_claim: Provides an independent scholarly interpretation of the 2025 operation.
sources.limitations: Public opinion is not proof of government intent. Survey methodology and operation-wide causal claims were not independently audited in this bounded lane. No survey percentages are used.

sources.title: Homeland Security Act of 2002, Public Law 107-296 (DHS supplement reread)
sources.locator: Sections 101–102, 222, 451, 471, 705; component transfers including Title XVII
sources.access_level: Original enacted law; supplements source H26 with new retrieval and locators
sources.short_claim: Creates department and divides immigration functions; establishes privacy and civil-rights offices.
sources.limitations: Formal safeguards are not proof of continuing staffing, access or effective remedies. H26 preserves the separate earlier retrieval rather than silently revising its date.
